{{Quote|Thank you, Obi-Wan! I have much to tell you about these thugs. They are receiving large shipments of arms and plan on turning Coruscant into a war zone.|The Quarren to Kenobi|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] '''informant''' worked for the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]]<ref name="ObiwanGuard" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">This event takes place before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> He infiltrated the [[Black Heth]] gang on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] but was discovered and captured. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent to [[Skirmishes on Coruscant|rescue]] the informant from the construction site he was being held at. At the beginning of his infiltration, Kenobi was contacted by his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who cautioned the younger Jedi to not raise any alarms, as the Black Heth might [[Death/Legends|kill]] the informant; Kenobi could monitor the informant on his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. Kenobi then fought his way down into the facility, eliminating the Black Heth thugs and their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] before they could set off an alarm. At the time, the Quarren was being interrogated to discover his identity. Kenobi was able to rescue the informant before his impending execution. The informant thanked the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and reported that the Black Heth was importing weapons. The two then left the facility.<ref name="SW:OW" />

The Quarren was referred to as a "brave friend" by Master Jinn.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quarren informant appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] during the game's first chapter in the mission ''The Informant.'' The player, in the guise of Kenobi, must infiltrate the Black Heth warehouse and rescue the informant. If the player fails to subdue the guards before they trigger an alarm, the Black Heth executes the informant and the mission fails. In the game, the Quarren informant is said to be working for the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]].

The character was credited as "Coruscant Informer" and was voiced by [[Joe Paulino]].
